title: Use parameterized string resource in DoseRow composable
name: DoseRow
description: The templated "$doseAmount at $time" text becomes a stringResource with two %s-style args.
acceptance_criteria: The dose-amount/time line uses stringResource(R.string.dose_at_time, doseLog.doseAmount, formatter.format(...))
medicationName Text() is unchanged (it's a variable, not a literal)
